real: a client that writes during the backups
a stop of each server, and the removal of each disk
a real mongodump of 1 MB with its oplog
a real mongorestore with a replay of the oplog
a set difference over each accepted write
synthetic: the interval of the backups is shortened: the record adds the interval of the rung to the measured excess
the data of the tenants is generated
the recovery starts at the fault: the RTO has no detection time and no human time
each member is a container on one runner, thus no network separates them

cells.name: RD.1 one node, disk lost, a dump with its oplog: each write after the dump goes, and no other
cells.why: 4 of the 4 counted runs are in the band of −4 ms to 1440.004 s. The median is 2.641 s, and its interval is 2.624 s to 2.65 s.

cells.name: RD.100.failover three members, the disk of the primary lost: an election loses no accepted write
cells.why: 4 of the 4 counted runs are in the band of 7.996 s to 15.004 s. The median is 10.503 s, and its interval is 10.2 s to 10.764 s.

cells.name: RD.100.restore three members, each disk lost, a dump and slices of the oplog: each write after the last slice goes, and no other
cells.why: 4 of the 4 counted runs are in the band of −4 ms to 180.004 s. The median is 15.273 s, and its interval is 15.038 s to 16.424 s.

cells.name: RD.1000.failover three members, 1 GB, the disk of the primary lost: an election loses no accepted write at this size
cells.why: 4 of the 4 counted runs are in the band of 7.996 s to 15.004 s. The median is 10.192 s, and its interval is 10.131 s to 10.327 s.

cells.name: RD.1000.restore three members, each disk lost, 1 GB, a dump and slices of the oplog: the time at a large size, and the same law
cells.why: 4 of the 4 counted runs are in the band of −4 ms to 90.004 s. The median is 21.968 s, and its interval is 21.505 s to 22.946 s.

cells.name: RD.control one node, disk lost after the dump with no later write: no write goes
cells.why: 4 of the 4 counted runs are in the band of −4 ms to 1440.004 s. The median is 2.565 s, and its interval is 2.543 s to 2.581 s.
